scientific_integrity: The infinite-family proof establishes the bound, all equality cases and exact labeled counts. The numerical checks reproduce finite cases; no independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only minimum quasi-total Roman functions, not all weight levels. Finite computations are corroborative rather than infinite verification; unindexed equivalent total-edge domination enumerations remain a bibliographic possibility.
title: Sharp quasi-total Roman domination and exact optimizers of rook graphs
